title: repetition
content_html:
repetition

In a sequence from certainty or reduce and return, some variations become visible only after several works. Repeating a movement or a line of writing can also make a small departure easier to notice. How does the act of repeating change what the artist or viewer expects to happen? The return can change the person who repeats it as well as the thing being repeated. Certainty · Imperfect Repetition Is the Condition for Growth

Reading note. Absurdism. Camus dwells on Sisyphus walking back down the mountain to his stone. The return is a moment of awareness within the recurring task. In a sequence from certainty or reduce and return, there is also a space between one work and the next. How does going back change the person doing the repeating? The Myth of Sisyphus, closing essay
